clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Skychaser the Elder appears atop Sentinel Tower in Westfall. Travelers climb to honor her and receive her blessing in return.

Sentinel Hill holds against Defias raiders and roving scavengers in Westfall's troubled scrublands. During the Lunar Festival, an ancestral spirit named Elder Skychaser appears on the open platform atop Sentinel Tower. From above the dust and wind, she watches over the weary soldiers and beleaguered settlers below. Anyone may climb the tower and pay her respect.

Across Azeroth, the Lunar Festival honors wisdom, heritage, and the deeds of ancient spirits who walked the earth before today's struggles. When you approach, Elder Skychaser recognizes the living spark within you. She accepts your homage and gives you a token of her favor, a bond between the living and the honored dead.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
